title: AwayKicker
description: A simple plugin that kicks you out when you're away.
body:
# AwayKicker - Getting rid of inactive players This plugin allows you to quickly remove inactive players. You can set the time it takes for a player to be kicked. ---
**Commands & Permissions:** Commands: - /awayreload (awaykicker.reload)
Other Permissions: - awaykicker.bypass (bypass the kick-process)
---
